Q5028.reason: The school designation was merely a proposal in a brochure and recorded plan, not a binding covenant or servitude, so it is an unenforceable restriction.

Q5787.reason: The defendant intended only a slight wound, not death or serious injury, so the unintended killing is involuntary manslaughter rather than murder.
